fix.summary: Coder-005's schema-only delta does not close Issue #33: two previously admitted real-seam proof gaps remain, the shipped v2 schemas still contradict the authority/runtime, and deletion of the former Recorder suites left required vertical invariants without current-head regression evidence.

classes.name: Counter-child invocation proof
classes.owner: Recorder invocation boundary (`src/recorder/config.ts`, `src/recorder/run.ts`, `src/recorder/spawn.ts`) and its production-seam tests
classes.boundary: Pre-spawn admission/rejection and the one real child spawn, including exact injected argv and effective environment
classes.disposition: Sustained proof gap. `test/recorder-config-session-integrity.test.ts` only calls `parseRecorderArgv`; no current Recorder test invokes `runRecorder` or a counter child. Thus it does not prove rejection before spawn, one spawn, insertion of absolute `--session-dir` and configured `--session-id` immediately after the executable, preservation of the remaining argv, removal of inherited `PI_SESSION_DIR`, or configured environment precedence at the production seam. Coder-004's gap remains.

classes.name: Active-read mutation oracle
classes.owner: Native session owner (`src/recorder/session.ts`) and its real-filesystem tests
classes.boundary: Mutation while the initial-size fd snapshot is actively streamed, distinct from mutation after `readSession` returns and before publication
classes.disposition: Sustained proof gap, not an authority-policy gate. The implementation has plausible production checks: fd metadata is compared before/after streaming, pathname and inventory are rebound, and `verify()` runs again before promotion. But the sole mutation test first completes `readSession`, then mutates, then calls `snapshot.verify()`. It deterministically proves only post-read verification, not replacement, growth, shrinkage, metadata change, or inventory mutation during the observed read as C2/C8 require. Existing authority already assigns this invariant to the session owner and leaves local Apply mechanisms open; it permits an internal production-seam deepening so long as it is a genuine owner abstraction rather than the forbidden test-only production hook. No requirement narrowing or owner decision is justified by the current evidence.

classes.name: Public v2 schema contract
classes.boundary: Shipped manifest/failure vocabulary and synchronization with runtime-emitted v2 objects
classes.disposition: Sustained implementation gap. `schemas/recorder-manifest-v2.schema.json` still explicitly permits `receipt: null` and retains legacy null-receipt branches, contrary to C7's non-null successful Receipt law. `schemas/recorder-failure-v2.schema.json` still enumerates stale diagnostic stage `cleanup`, omits runtime stage `session`, and omits runtime invalid-config location segments `session` and `directory`. Therefore Code5's claim that the schema delta removed the stale cleanup claim and completed the runtime vocabulary is false. No current test parses these schemas against lawful and counterexample v2 objects.

classes.name: Whole-ticket vertical regression proof
classes.owner: Recorder end-to-end and package regression suites
classes.boundary: C6/C8 transaction, promotion, derivation, role-lifecycle, and installed-package behavior through production Recorder seams
classes.disposition: Sustained proof gap. Current HEAD deleted all prior Recorder admission, CLI, transaction, failure-contract, manifest-schema, package-lifecycle, and extract/scan suites, while adding only 15 narrow Recorder tests; the full 299-test run passes but contains no `runRecorder` test. Consequently current tests do not substantiate retained admission-before-spawn, exact child exit/signal versus sealer-failure precedence, stdin and separate stream behavior through spawn, derivative scan/redaction truth, successful native lifecycles for all five roles, atomic no-replace publication races, raw-session exclusion from dockets, or installed Recorder success/failure behavior. Those invariants were not deleted by the v2 authority merely because their v1-era suites disappeared, so the green full-suite count cannot carry the whole-ticket burden.

details.note: HEAD was verified as `994494e0ef2c95e945a17d9673eb3c10ed8a81cc`; `npm test` mechanically passes 299 tests (294 pass, 5 skips), but that result does not cross the missing Recorder seams. The active-read implementation may already enforce the intended invariant, but Apply convergence requires the explicitly mandated deterministic during-read oracle. The public schema contradictions are independently sufficient to reject Coder-005's `completed` claim.
